overview.description: The Xtrackers MSCI Eurozone Hedged Equity ETF (DBEZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of stocks from eurozone nations and hedges out the currency fluctuations of the euro relative to the US dollar. DBEZ was launched on Dec 10, 2014 and is issued by Xtrackers.
